json.evidence: None of photos 1-15 shows a round electric meter or a meter socket enclosure. Photos 1, 5, 6, 14 and 15 show large grey steel doors labelled as transformer rooms ('F 51.2 Traforaum') with high-voltage warning signs. Photos 3, 8, 11 and 12 show a louvered outdoor switchgear or transformer cabinet with scaffolding carrying orange cables and white conduit. Photos 2, 9, 10 and 13 show building entrances ('64', 'Anlieferung HPP' delivery door with keypad) and an open utility room with a radiator. Photos 4 and 7 show a parking lot and trees.
